test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'CAST’ is written as '311920', and 'FEED' is written as '6554'.How will 'GLAD' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

Logic: Place value of the letters of given word = Code of given word.

Now,

'CAST’ is written as '311920'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd1b68c78b2bc7d25837e4034494d4cf0c6511dd9c6a25b3922ec3a2e7ee40c2.png] 

'FEED' is written as '6554'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ebec529ac221c7a13694f375c4a494cfaf74c51260d96280921d24291ff4de9.png] 

Similarly, for **'GLAD'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57bd750c7781b59fcb3b3893d8b8ebbd4b5b9ee1f29c820b18ef5f7f0aad3b3d.png] 

So, 'GLAD' will be coded as '**71214**'

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
